cohort: 120 patients who underwent cesarean section and subsequent surgical treatment for abdominal wall incision endometriosis were included.
finding: The application of sterile distilled water rinsing significantly reduced pain, improved quality of life, increased satisfaction, and lowered complication rates compared to saline rinsing for patients with abdominal wall incision endometriosis after cesarean section, with 0.5% povidone-iodine rinse also showing significant benefits over saline.
